lines: #There's one thing on your list you've been *avoiding.*
#The call. The *email.* The workout. The task you keep pushing to *later.*
#And because you're avoiding it, it follows you *all* day.
It sits in the back of your mind. Draining your *energy.*
Before the emails. Before the *scroll.* Before your energy runs out.
The rest of the day feels *lighter.*
And you walk around with the quiet confidence of someone who already *won.*
It's never as bad as your mind made it *seem.*
The dread is worse than the *doing.*
#Most people save the hard thing for *later.*
Find the hardest thing on your list.
end: Follow for your daily push at 7am & 7pm.

post.title: Do the Hardest Thing First
post.caption: The task you're avoiding follows you all day. Kill it first. 🎯
post.first_comment: What's the hardest thing on your list today? 👇
